name: Roofers Royal Oak Roof Maintenance Record
author: roofersroyaloak

sections.description:
Keep a simple record of professional maintenance and questions for your next appointment. Download it before leaving this page.

Add the Roofers Royal Oak Roof Maintenance Record block or [royalrmr_roof_maintenance_record] shortcode. Labelled keyboard controls, isolated repeat instances and a responsive layout inherit your site’s font and text colour. Download a plain-text summary or use Print summary. No account, API, analytics, cookies, lead capture or visitor-data storage. All inputs stay in the current page until you download them. The tool sends nothing to a provider.

Records stay on this page until you download them; this tool does not save or remind you. It does not diagnose a roof or recommend inspection, repairs or access. Dates and notes are supplied by you. Discuss maintenance intervals and any concerns with your qualified provider.

No administrator configuration is needed.

All functionality works without attribution.

Developed by Roofers Royal Oak.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it on a single-site staging install.
  2. Add the Roofers Royal Oak Roof Maintenance Record block, or a Shortcode block containing [royalrmr_roof_maintenance_record].
  3. Preview the page and verify the tool in your theme before publishing.
sections.faq:
Does it save my information?

No. Reloading or leaving the page loses inputs. Download a summary if you want to keep it. There are no reminders, provider messages or background tasks.

Can I change the heading?

Use the block sidebar, or [royalrmr_roof_maintenance_record title=”My planning tool”].

How many rows can I add?

Add up to 50 maintenance records. Leave unused records blank; enter a valid date and work description for every record you use before downloading the summary.

What are its limits?

Records stay on this page until you download them; this tool does not save or remind you. It does not diagnose a roof or recommend inspection, repairs or access. Dates and notes are supplied by you. Discuss maintenance intervals and any concerns with your qualified provider.

Is multisite supported?

This release supports single-site installations. Network activation and network-wide uninstall cleanup are not validated or implemented. Uninstall removes this site’s settings only.
